description: This file defines the 'SocketReceiver' class within the Orleans.Networking.Shared namespace, responsible for handling asynchronous socket receive operations using pipelines.

classes.name: SocketReceiver
classes.description: A sealed class that inherits from SocketSenderReceiverBase, implementing methods for asynchronous data reception over sockets.

methods.name: WaitForDataAsync
methods.description: Begins waiting asynchronously for data to be received on the socket, returning an awaitable event args object.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous receive operation into the specified memory buffer.
